in_marathi.name: Kumudlata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumudlata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kumud’ (lotus) and ‘lata’ (born). The name signifies a woman who is as beautiful as a lotus flower, born in the divine pond of life.
